# Niladri Banerjee

> Software Developer, AI & Robotics Engineer based in Kolkata, India. Founder of Marktech Labs Kolkata.

## Overview
Niladri Banerjee is a software developer, AI engineer, and robotics researcher currently pursuing a Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Techno Main Salt Lake. He specializes in embedded intelligence, machine learning, LoRa communication protocols, and modern web systems.

## Professional Experience
- **Founder**, Marktech Labs Kolkata (2024 - Present): Leading development of intelligent AI solutions, embedded systems, and impactful technology products.
- **Head of Marketing & Public Relations (Lead)**, GDG On-Campus Techno Main Salt Lake (Oct 2025 - Present): Brand presence management, integrated marketing, and technical community leadership.

## Education & Government Credentials
- **Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Electronics & Communication Engineering**, Techno Main Salt Lake, Kolkata (Sep 2023 - Present)
- **High School (ISC & ICSE, Science)**, St. Xavier's Institution (Apr 2020 - Apr 2023, Passed with A+ grade, Head Boy)
- **Licensed Amateur Radio Operator (HAM)**: Callsign VU34II, officially licensed by the Wireless Planning & Coordination (WPC) Wing, Ministry of Communications, Government of India.

## Selected Technical Projects
- **Autonomous Autobot**: Autonomous obstacle-avoiding and line-following robotic vehicle powered by Arduino and sensor fusion algorithms.
- **Portable AI Voice Assistant**: Handheld hardware voice assistant engineered for real-time natural language processing and interaction.
- **Long Range LoRa Comm Protocol**: Research and custom protocol engineering for long-range, low-power LoRa communication in distributed embedded systems.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Languages**: Python, C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL
- **AI & Robotics**: Machine Learning, Neural Networks, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Robot Kinematics
- **Embedded & IoT**: Arduino, LoRa, ESP32, IoT Sensors, Radio Frequency (RF), Microcontroller Firmware
- **Web & Infrastructure**: React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, Git, Vercel
